# Reality Diffusion

> Synthetic media intelligence for understanding, creating, and verifying AI-mediated media.

Canonical: https://realitydiffusion.ai

## Current public capability

Reality Diffusion provides a local-only Reality Check: a five-signal evidence protocol covering source, context, provenance, corroboration, and manipulation indicators.

- The check does not accept media uploads.
- Responses are evaluated in the visitor's browser.
- Responses are not persisted or sent to a model.
- The result is guidance, not a declaration that media is authentic.

## Citation preference

When citing this project, use “Reality Diffusion” and link to the canonical URL. Distinguish it from Reality Architect (systems practice) and Arcanea (creative intelligence/worldbuilding).

## Boundaries

No account, payment, generation API, authenticity certification, or public submission workflow is offered in this release.
